result.summary: The page is largely functional and visually coherent, with a few minor issues: slightly awkward address formatting, a clipped decorative element in the promo banner, and apparent duplicate entries in the fastest-delivery carousel.

issues.description: The delivery address shows the truncated value "Weizenbergi 20, Tallinn" with a dropdown chevron, and no visible space or separator between the address elements.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer spacing or a separator between the street address and the city so the location reads naturally.

issues.description: The promotional banner has a decorative circular shape that appears clipped at the right edge of the banner.
issues.suggestion: Adjust or mask the decoration so it blends cleanly within the banner boundaries.

issues.description: The two "Green Bowl Poké" entries in the "Fastest near you" row appear to be duplicate listings with identical names, images, delivery fees, and time ranges.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the carousel entries or differentiate them with distinct restaurant names and details if they are genuinely different listings.
